status: 나그네새 수천 마리 · 겨울철새 수십 마리
habitat: 산림, 숲 가장자리, 침엽수림, 도시의 정원과 공원
summary: 우리나라에 불규칙하게 찾아오는 겨울철새로, 산림 가운데서도 숲 가장자리와 침엽수림, 도시의 정원과 공원 등지에서 지낸다. 주된 번식지는 러시아 동부의 산림이며, 침엽수 위에 나뭇가지와 지의류, 풀로 접시 모양 둥지를 짓고 검은 반점이 박힌 옅은 청색 알을 4~6개 낳는다. 한국, 중국, 일본 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Japanese Waxwing (Bombycilla japonica), adult in winter (November–March): soft pinkish grey-brown plumage with a long, swept-back crest; forehead and cheeks rich reddish-chestnut; a narrow black stripe from the bill base through the eye runs back along the crest to its tip; small black chin and throat patch; back and wing coverts grey-brown, rump blue-grey; wings black and grey with a dark red band formed by red tips to the greater coverts; breast pinkish-brown fading to a blue-grey belly with a pale yellow centre; undertail coverts rusty-red; tail grey at the base, black towards the end, with a red tip; short black bill; dark eye; black legs.
art.pose: perched on a branch, side view
art.scene: Korean winter woodland edge with conifers beside a park; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a berry-laden twig: swept-back crest with the black eye-stripe running to its tip, reddish-chestnut forehead and cheeks, black chin, pinkish-brown body, blue-grey belly with a pale yellow centre, rusty-red vent, red-tipped tail
adult, seen from behind and slightly above, perched: blue-grey rump, grey-and-black tail with a red tip, dark red band across the folded wing, black flight feathers
art.build: Plump, compact songbird, 18cm — clearly larger than a sparrow, smaller than a starling, with a starling-like silhouette in flight. Large head with a soft, pointed crest swept back from the crown. Bill short, black and broad-based, much shorter than the head. Legs short and black. Wings fairly long and pointed. Tail short and square-ended. Perches upright in tight flocks in treetops and feeds on berries, often hanging among fruiting twigs.
avoid: Do not paint a yellow tail tip or yellow and white marks in the wing — those belong to Bohemian Waxwing (Bombycilla garrulus); this species has a red tail tip.
Do not stop the black eye-stripe at the base of the crest; it runs right along the crest to the tip.
Do not paint red waxy droplets on the secondaries as in Bohemian Waxwing.
Do not paint a long thin bill or long legs.
